name: @aethelred/wallet-agent-budget
description: AgentBudget: on-chain per-agent rolling-window spend caps + scoped session keys. Ships the canonical AgentBudget.sol reference contract, precomputed function selectors, calldata encoders, a session-key module (grant/spend/revoke), and a budget client that talks to any viem/ethers-backed RPC through a pluggable ChainProvider. The on-chain trust boundary between a parent agent and its short-lived delegated sessions.
